not: Not independent admission, not regrading, not owner approval. The independent reviewer answers each dossier.

flag_definitions.TEST_MISSING: A referenced acceptance identity is absent from the effective registry.
flag_definitions.TEST_NOT_BOUND_TO_OWNER: A referenced identity belongs to no unit that owns this requirement.
flag_definitions.OWNERSHIP_MISMATCH: Units on the requirement record differ from plan.requirement_ownership.
flag_definitions.NO_OWNER: No unit owns the requirement in plan.requirement_ownership.
flag_definitions.NO_NEGATIVE_OR_RECOVERY: No referenced identity or acceptance clause names a negative/adversarial or recovery case.
flag_definitions.SUBJECTIVE_ACCEPTANCE: Acceptance rests on owner/screenshot judgement with no stated observable.
flag_definitions.UNDERSPECIFIED_ACCEPTANCE: Requirement acceptance and every linked expectation are under 6 words, too short to state stimulus and observable.
flag_definitions.TEMPLATE_ACCEPTANCE: Acceptance is a shared template sentence, so the requirement-specific oracle lives only in the referenced tests.
flag_definitions.DUPLICATE_TEXT: Another requirement has the same normalised text.
flag_definitions.OWNER_QUESTION_OPEN: An owning unit has an unresolved owner question gating it.
flag_definitions.GATE_UNIT_WITHOUT_ACCEPTANCE: An owning unit has no acceptance identities in the admitted plan (AP-001).
flag_definitions.NO_PRODUCT_TRUTH_TRACE: No product-truth atom maps to this requirement.
